points: Baseline: generative AI could add EUR 440bn a year in value added to Germany by 2034
Restricted training-data access cuts that by EUR 155bn, mainly via weaker models (EUR 75bn)
Commission has reviewed the EU Copyright Directive since May 2026; authors urge keeping the TDM exception
read: ifo press release, 13 October 2026 (study by Implement Consulting Group with ifo)
take: Copyright review of EU text-and-data-mining rules could cut Germany's generative-AI upside by a third. Study commissioned by CCIA Europe and Google, so weigh accordingly.
title: ifo: tighter AI training-data rules could cost Germany EUR 155bn
